headline: Up-day thread, first night: every check agrees - the index shows no continuation after a morning reading, long stock selection on up days isn't there yet, and our live ETF trades simply track the index.
bullets: Leadership breadth (top-20 S&P weights above open) improves the up-day call (82% vs 72%) but not the return left (t 0.37) - closed.
Long lab setups on up-reading days (162k trades): no edge once SPY's move is removed (TRAIN -0.002, VALID -0.001 ATR); GEN, ST1, ST7 are weak leads.
Live leveraged/index ETF trades (739): R tracks the index (corr 0.82); bullish ones lost 83R, worst when entered with an up reading.
Replay: its +0.054R optimism is likely fills at the decision price vs the measured ~+0.04R live drift - being re-checked.
Next: one look at tiered 3x-ETF scale-outs vs the null; a 2-year look at the late-day ETF dip long (the one positive live shape).
